identity.name: CredWiz.exe Usage for Credential Export
identity.summary: An attacker uses credwiz.exe to export stored credentials from Windows credential manager. Cortex should detect the process execution and associated file access patterns.
identity.description: An attacker uses credwiz.exe to export stored credentials from Windows credential manager. Cortex should detect the process execution and associated file access patterns.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Stored Credentials Exported via CredWiz
biocs.description: Detection of credwiz.exe process execution with export flag
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'credwiz.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/export'

abiocs.name: Suspicious CredWiz Execution Pattern
abiocs.description: Detection of credwiz.exe being executed with export flag from non-standard location
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'credwiz.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/export'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: credwiz.exe process start with export flag

xql_queries.name: CredWiz Export Activity
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'credwiz.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '/export'
| comp count() by agent_hostname, action_process_command_line
